colors.name: Studio Charcoal
colors.role: Page canvas, primary background - a near-black with a green undertone that reads as neutral but feels warmer than pure black

colors.name: Gallery Black
colors.role: Feature bands, specimen backgrounds, header bar - pure black for maximum type contrast

colors.name: Charcoal Surface
colors.role: Elevated surface, input fields, secondary panel backgrounds - one step lighter than the canvas

colors.name: Slate Mist
colors.role: Muted accent band, tertiary surface - desaturated blue-gray used as an alternate section background

colors.name: Graphite
colors.role: Mid-tone borders, muted body text on light sections, card outlines

colors.name: Steel
colors.role: Secondary borders, subdued link text on dark backgrounds

colors.name: Fog
colors.role: Tertiary borders, inactive UI elements, secondary text

colors.name: Ash
colors.role: Medium-contrast borders, control outlines, and structural separators. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

colors.name: Marble
colors.role: Light-mode page canvas, pale gray that photographs cleanly for specimen presentations

colors.name: Bone
colors.role: Primary text on dark backgrounds, type specimen letterforms, button labels, high-contrast surfaces

colors.name: Flare Orange
colors.role: Label tags, collection names, editorial annotations - a saturated vermilion that reads as the foundry's signature mark on light backgrounds

colors.name: Signal Red
colors.role: Hot accent on dark surfaces, inline highlights, the reddest red in the palette for maximum voltage

colors.name: Electric Blue
colors.role: Interactive highlights, active states, link emphasis - a bright cyan-blue that pops against black

colors.name: Mint Pulse
colors.role: Decorative text accent, special-occasion highlights - a pale mint used sparingly for emphasis

colors.name: Canary
colors.role: Rare chromatic accent, used for the highest-attention text moment on dark backgrounds

colors.name: Blush
colors.role: Soft warm accent, subtle text tint - a cream-pink that warms dark sections without competing with type

fonts.name: SOEHNE
fonts.role: SOEHNE - detected in extracted data but not described by AI

fonts.name: Sohne
fonts.role: Primary UI typeface - used for navigation, body text, buttons, form labels, and all functional interface text. Tight line-heights (0.98-1.20) at display sizes; generous (1.50) for body. Two weights only: regular for content, bold for emphasis. Tabular numerals via tnum for price alignment; ordinals via ordn.

fonts.name: Sohne Ikon
fonts.role: Iconographic variant of Sohne for interface glyphs, special characters, and numeric UI elements. Same voice as Sohne but with alternate character forms via calt and tabular figures via tnum.

do: Set all primary UI text in Sohne 16px/400 with Sohne 700 for emphasis only
Use Flare Orange (#d33c03) for label tags, collection names, and editorial annotations - this is the foundry's signature mark
Alternate specimen band backgrounds between #000000, #1c1c1c, #3c585f, and #f9f9f9 to create rhythm without dividers
Use 2px border-radius on all interactive elements (buttons, tags, inputs) - this near-sharp corner is the system's geometric signature
Set type specimens in the typeface they represent at 36px+ - the font IS the content
Enable tnum and ordn font features on all Sohne usage for consistent number and ordinal rendering
Maintain tight spacing: 8px component padding, 10px element gaps, 20px horizontal page padding
doNot: Do not introduce drop shadows, gradients, or glow effects - the system is flat and shadowless
Do not use border-radius greater than 2px - the design is intentionally near-sharp
Do not use color on large background fills - chromatic colors are reserved for tiny label tags and text accents
Do not set body or display type in colors other than Bone (#ffffff on dark) or Graphite (#555555 on light) - chromatic type is for special emphasis only
Do not add visible section dividers or whitespace gaps larger than ~69px between bands - the background color shift IS the divider
Do not use system fonts for UI text - Sohne is the voice of the interface
Do not place more than one chromatic color in a single component - each color punch gets its own moment
